6Select topics to enable the queue action
Select the lab that should do the work. Check its current research and waiting queue.
Tap one or several available topics. Number badges show their selection order; tap a selected topic again to remove it from the selection.
Tap ADD TO LAB QUEUE. Review the accepted queue. Use × beside a waiting topic to remove that waiting entry.
Each lab queue holds up to 64 waiting topics. Completed, started or already queued topics cannot be duplicated in another lab.
